# Seals, gaskets, tapes and lens materials for the sealed panel (PCB-C C5)

Maker data sheets and distributor pages behind `v2/docs/respin-research-seal-2026-09-04.md`, the sourcing pass for the rain- and dust-proof panel face (MESHSAT-709, owner ruling of 4 September 2026). Every file was downloaded on 4 September 2026 unless the row says otherwise. The same licence remark as the parent folder applies: these documents belong to their makers and are kept here so the design record can be checked against the same pages later; a rights holder who wants one removed opens an issue and it goes.

Nothing in this folder has been built or tested on a kit. The panel that uses these parts is the C5 respin, which is designed and not yet ordered.
